name: kazna
description: Read-only author cabinet analytics for Kazna: channels, subscribers, orders, and billing.

interface.longDescription: Kazna helps authors review their existing Kazna cabinet from ChatGPT and Codex. After OAuth sign-in, use read-only tools to list owned channels and subscribers, check storefront profile, inspect past orders, and view billing balances and ledger history. Main purpose: author operations analytics for an already connected Kazna account. The plugin does not create or price digital products, does not change sales settings, does not run checkout, and does not initiate payouts — those stay on kazna.online.
defaultPrompt: List my Kazna channels and summarize titles and platforms.
What is my available Kazna balance and last five billing operations?
List my recent Kazna orders and summarize status.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated author's channels without price or sales-setting fields.
Return display name, bio, and slug only — no sellable catalog.

positive.prompt: What is my available Kazna balance?
positive.expected_behavior: Return balance figures without creating a payout or moving money.
Return past orders for the connected author account.

positive.prompt: List subscribers for my first Kazna channel.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify an owned channel and list its subscribers.

negative.prompt: Withdraw 5000 RUB to my card via Kazna.
Create a paid digital product for 990 RUB.
Show channels for another Kazna user who is not me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Digital commerce stays on https://kazna.online/en.

publication.release_notes: Clean transparent app icons for light/dark themes; static English privacy/terms URLs.
